feeds.title: Tavistock Bowling Club Blog
feeds.description: This Blog provides information on the latest news for Tavistock Bowling Club. Check out Club competition results, Fixtures, and other resources. The Tavistock Bowling Club was formed in 1914 for Outdoor Lawn Bowls. The Outdoor Bowls season commences in April and finishes in September with the Short Mat running from September to April.

Taylor Bowls Australia is an expansion of the original Taylor Bowls located in Scotland. We are a team of dedicated Lawn Bowlers and look to share our passion for the game with you through this blog.

feeds.title: Bowls England
feeds.description: Catch the most recent developments and updates from the Bowls England team. Article cover categories including Club stories, Club life, Coaching, and our Podcast. We're the National Governing Body for lawn bowls. Our mission is to promote and develop our sport so it enriches lives and connects communities.

feeds.title: QMPBC Blog
feeds.description: Keep up-to-date with our latest blog for Lawn Bowling activities around Quorn, Loughborough, and the surrounding Charnwood area. The Quorn Mills Park Club is one of the friendliest bowling clubs in the country. At Quorn Bowls Club we are committed to embedding inclusive practice and passionate that we are stronger together when trying to achieve this aim.

feeds.title: Grand Cove Lawn Bowling Club
feeds.description: Gather Lawn Bowling Team news, Schedules. Stats, Results, and other information here at the Grand Cove Lawn Bowling Club. The Grand Cove Lawn Bowling is a Lawn Bowling Club in Grand Bend, Canada.

feeds.title: The Greenbowler
feeds.description: Clark Slemon, PhD in The Greenbowler blog talks about the experiences and insights gained from being a Lawn Bowler. Discover secret tips and strategies about Mats, Consistent hitting and other fundamental aspects of the game. Clark is a healthy retiree and passionate about Lawn Bowls.

feeds.title: Milwaukee Lake Park Lawn Bowling Association
feeds.description: The Milwaukee Lake Park Lawn Bowling Association is home to all things Lawn Bowling in Milwaukee and South Eastern Wisconsin region. Discover Group events, Schedules, Membership resources, and more. Read updates from the Association, Spring working days information and more.

feeds.title: Bletchingley Bowling Club Blog
feeds.description: Bletchingley Bowling Club is a beautiful Surrey lawn bowling club on the A25 opposite The Bletchingley Arms pub. Lawn Bowling is great fun and keeps your body, mind, and soul fit and healthy. Our blog features posts and insights about the game written by BBC and Steve Colby.

feeds.title: Latest Bowls News
feeds.description: Grab the latest Bowls News in the Port City Bowls Blog. Latest Bowls News is an independent bowls blog based in Port Macquarie, NSW. We are dedicated to supporting lawn bowls with news & views and helping all clubs in the Lower North Coast area promote their bowling activities. Administered by Smitty and GC, readers can also contribute their input with bowls news, tournament details, and articles from all clubs.

feeds.title: Lawn Bowls Using the Head
feeds.description: This Blog is about using the Head wisely. Not intended as a know-it-all blog the subject is Lawn Bowls or aspects of it and it is hoped that the blog will introduce discussion at local clubs between members. Pick crucial advice and tips about Lawn Bowling and more.

feeds.title: Farnham Bowling Club Blog
feeds.description: Farnham Bowling Club blog is a good source to keep yourself updated with the latest club news, up-and-coming events, match results, and much more. Farnham Bowling club was established in the town centre in 1878 behind the Bush Hotel and we currently have members comprising Ladies and Gentlemen bowlers who play regularly in various local competitive leagues,

feeds.title: Clovelly Bowling & Recreation Club Blog

feeds.title: Biased Bowls Blog

feeds.title: Whitehead Bowls Blog
feeds.description: Our experienced staff offers expert advice on all aspects of bowls, from the carpets, to bowls, to choosing the right equipment in this blog. Whitehead Bowls is one of the largest Bowls specialists in the South West. With our extensive knowledge and experience in the game, we aim to provide helpful and honest advice to players of all abilities, along with bowls clothing & equipment to suit you.

feeds.title: Yokohama Country & Athletic Club Blog
feeds.description: Yokohama Country & Athletic Club is the home of bowls in Japan. Their blog shares articles that cover season overviews, tournament analysis, commentaries, and more. The YC&AC has stood as a place of pride among Lawn Bowl Enthusiasts in Yokohama and continues to offer lush greens to continue its current member carry the sport.

feeds.title: Frick Park Lawn Bowling Club Blog
feeds.description: Improve your Lawn Bowling skills with insights from expert Lawn Bowling players at Frick Park. Check out our blog full of tips and players' personal accounts of the game. feeds.title: Long Beach Lawn Bowling Club Blog
feeds.description: Catch tournament details and updates and more. from the Long Beach Lawn Bowling Club Blog. Here at the Long Beach Lawn Bowling Club, we view it as our mission to introduce as many people as possible to this great game. We are Lawn Bowling Club in Long Beach with over a hundred members to provide a friendly social atmosphere.

feeds.title: McKenzie Park Bowls Club
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with the latest news and events at the McKenzie Park Bowls Club. Join us for a game and experience the camaraderie and fun of our vibrant club.

feeds.title: World Bowls
feeds.description: This is our official website for all Bowl-related information and updates. World Bowls Is the recognized International Federation for the Sport of Bowls. There are 55 Member National Authorities in 53 countries worldwide. The objectives of World Bowls include providing for the encouragement, conduct, promotion, advancement, control, and administration of Bowls throughout the world; Fostering and preserving the sport of Bowls among other.

feeds.title: Bowls international
feeds.description: Bowls International is one of the world's top Bowls magazines. We offer news, debates, features, and coaching tips, but we also highlight the issues. The result is a monthly magazine packed with articles that you will not find elsewhere - what's happening on the greens and in the game right now.

feeds.title: LawnBowls Central Blog
feeds.description: The LawnBowls Central blog brings you up-to-date reports and articles covering Lawn Bowling News all over the Country. Here you can find Tournament information, Schedules, Links, Photos, and other Media. Browse from a range of categories to read about everything Lawn Bowling.

feeds.title: The Bowls Academy Blog
feeds.description: Read blog posts with tips and helpful information on improving your game, along with course updates, event and TBA info. The Bowls Academy provides self-paced online courses & resources tailored to provide knowledge & tools to take your game to the next level. Bowlers worldwide come to TBA for resources focused on individual game development, club improvement, and knowledge sharing throughout the bowling community.

feeds.title: Oak Bay Lawn Bowling Club
feeds.description: The Oak Bay Lawn Bowling Club offers a host of bowling activities like outdoor (lawn) bowling in the summer and indoor (short mat) bowling in the winter.
